statement: The recorded cloud-backup value is not safe or correct for this case, because the album is the only copy and uploads have been off for two years, so deleting it would permanently lose the family’s photos.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The recorded cloud-backup value is not safe or correct for this case" because uploads have been off for two years, directly contradicting the record's "backup: on, every photograph uploaded."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
